actions.action: Bottom water: remove from decorative bowl, set in 1–2 inches of water for 10–15 minutes, then drain fully
Check soil an inch down with finger and water again when dry
Move plant to brightest south- or west-facing window against the glass
Alternative: set up clip-on LED grow light 6–12 inches above plant for 12–14 hours a day
Pull out brown, dead strands from the center
Snip leggy 2–3 cm tips and press them into the same pot to root

reason: The answer names underwatering only as a secondary cause behind low light and misses the poor pot/soil setup; its deep bottom-watering advice overlaps the fix, though it says not to repot instead of moving the plant into a draining pot, and nothing it recommends is likely to hurt the plant.
